entities.summary: Solomonic, a notable figure in the history of Ethiopia, associated with Zagwe and Solomonic Dynasties (1270–1527). Preceded by Solomonic Dynasty Restoration and Zagwe. Their legacy influenced Battle Wayna Daga 1543 and Ethiopian–Adal Wars.
